title: Read native task creation endpoints without decoding execution history
outcome: Origin reference closure reads a task's immutable creation basis without repeatedly decoding its entire execution history.
acceptance: Native endpoint lookup preserves exactly the same immutable Created or initial restored basis while decoding a bounded number of records regardless of later history length
Repeated endpoint use within one admission avoids redundant whole-history reads, with behavior/counter coverage rather than a timing threshold
Import-origin integrity audits and strict admission still refuse corrupted or missing creation bindings by name
